selection: Eight per each frozen sampling-length bin by fixed SHA256 order before provider outputs. Source and provider identity masking are different: reviewers may see source/context but provider names remain masked.
full_reference_review: Label each provider separately for broad meaning preservation, material error, uncertainty, or unchanged/invalid. Preserve context-needed uncertainty and time convention. Fluency alone is not correctness.
span_review: Label selected10%-window scopes separately from full-reference labels. Prior full-reference errors do not automatically make every focus wrong; exact agreement is not alignment gold. Inspect original focus, target focus, full texts and source/target ranges.
masking: Provider A/B order determined by fixed hash of caseID; key kept separate until both reviews are frozen. The current control remains identifiable as a different strategy, not a disguised independent provider.
decision_policy: Do not tune matcher/provider prompt on these80 then treat them as validation. Any change requires a new holdout.
context: Review-only preceding context may reveal source intent. Report source-alone confidence separately where prior-turn context is necessary; no model receives that context in this arm.
